head_commit.message:
inside.py: set LEAN_NUM_THREADS for the audit phase too (verifier#188)

195060b2 set threads only in the else branch, so the audit phase reached
os.execve without it and raised NameError. Every run since 195060b2 that
reached the axiom audit failed there. threads = '4' is now set before the
branches; the build phase still takes its worker count from the controller.

The only unit test of inside.py covered the build phase; the audit, lean,
nanoda and -exec phases ran only in real sandbox runs. A new test runs
every phase with a stubbed execve and checks the path, the args and
LEAN_NUM_THREADS=4 (and the control/bin PATH for the -exec phases). It
fails with the NameError on 195060b2.

Reported by AnanasClassic in verifier#188. The test idea is from darkhipo's
PR #189; this code is written by the maintainers.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
